rows.title: The stored notification record says which set it belongs to, and each set opens only its own notifications
rows.detail: Germinal products is a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend and both keep their notifications in the one animals backend, so the stored record is what tells the two apart. The backend's create takes the category the set starting the notification sends and holds it at the root of the record, beside its status and reference; no later save, submit, amend, cancel-amend or copy changes it. A record with no category is read as live animals everywhere, so every notification stored before the germinal set exists stays a live-animals notification without a data migration. A notification holds commodities of its one category only, never a mix, so choosing the other type in the journey starts a new notification of that category and the abandoned draft keeps the category it was created with. The read the frontend opens a notification with hands the category back, so each set's entry guard can refuse the other category's notifications. The category stays on the record: it travels on no notification event, so the event envelope and the shared event schemas stay as they are. The field's name and values are the animals backend's to choose in its own conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft the germinal products set creates is stored with the category germinal products, and a draft the live-animals set creates is stored with the category live animals, held at the root of the record beside its status and reference. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-001, repo-backend-p1-002, repo-backend-p2-001)

A notification stored with no category on its record is read as live animals: it opens, saves and submits in the live-animals set, with no data migration. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-035; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-002)

Saving, submitting, amending, cancelling an amendment and copying a notification leave its stored category as it was created with, so a copy of a germinal products notification is a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-001)

A notification holds commodities of its one category only: choosing the other type from a live-animals draft starts a new notification of that category, and the abandoned draft keeps the category live animals. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, -p1-054, -p1-055, -p1-056)

The read the animals frontend opens a notification with returns the stored category, and live animals for a record that has none, so opening a germinal products notification through a live-animals page, or a live-animals notification through a germinal products page, shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-019; repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-075)

The outbox events published for a germinal products notification carry the same envelope fields as a live-animals notification's: id, aggregate id and type, sub-type, version, event type, timestamp, data, actor, status changes and metadata. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-200; c-272, c-296)
rows.gate: Look at the category on the stored record and the cross-set guard before the other germinal page copies follow: every later germinal row rests on a record that says which set it belongs to.
rows.notes: Combines the category on the record, set on create and never changed, and returned on the read the frontend rehydrates from: one backend field, one create path and one read, observable only through the germinal set's create and the cross-set guard, so it belongs with the germinal set's first row. c-272 and c-296 (the 9 October afternoon ruling) settle that the category is not published on any event and that the shared event schemas do not change, so the envelope criterion states the fields the envelope carries rather than the withdrawn category field; no criterion here restates the overruled claims that the category travels on the event or that the read model takes it from there. Known gap recorded by that ruling: until the other service's dashboard is re-distilled, its table lists germinal notifications without their category; that is a reconcile matter, not a row. The field's name and values are the animals backend's to choose. The record root and the create path are also changed by the overview-and-review theme's submit row, and the live-animals entry guard is journey-foundation code, so both are listed under shared; the germinal theme already lands after both. The criterion about choosing the other type is observable once the type question exists, which the type-question-and-templates branch builds, so the existing row's external dependency on it stands. Combiner: merge this draft into the row named in existingRow, keeping its id, theme, repos, dependsOn and externalDependsOn, and merge these criteria with the germinal-products, notification-list, journey-flow and layout-and-sign-in areas' drafts of the same row.

rows.title: A germinal consignment's temperature is stored unpublished, germinal notifications publish on today's profile, and live trade lines carry their type code
rows.detail: The germinal set always asks the consignment's temperature. The current published profile has no field for it, so the animals backend is its only home: it stores the answer and shows it back, and the published payload carries none of it. A germinal products notification is published on the same events and payload as a live-animals one, carrying only what the gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 profile already defines; the sections the germinal set never asks (unweaned animals, the CPH number, per-animal permanent addresses) are left out, as the mapper leaves out any unanswered section. No profile version, shared data shape or gateway mapping changes for the germinal set's own details: the profile update for them is another team's work, outside this backlog. Once germinal trade lines carry their own type codes, every live-animal trade line says what it is too.
acceptanceCriteria: A temperature saved on the germinal set's Commodity details page is stored on the notification and shown again when that page is reopened. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-040, -p1-042; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-002)

A submitted germinal products notification is published on the same GBN-AG events as a live-animals one, and its payload validates against the gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 profile. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016 to -p1-018, -p1-043; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112; repo:backend repo-backend-p6-001)
That payload carries only fields the gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 profile defines, so the consignment's temperature stays in the animals backend. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040 to -p1-043)

That payload carries the sections the germinal set asks, and the mapper leaves out unweaned animals, the CPH number and per-animal permanent addresses, as it leaves out any unanswered section of a live-animals notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p6-033)

In the published GBN-AG payload every live-animal trade line carries typeCode LIVE_ANIMAL. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-039; repo:backend repo-backend-p6-109, repo-backend-p6-039; c-273)
rows.notes: Combines the temperature's storage, the germinal publishing on today's profile and the live-animal trade line's type code: one change to the record's content and one to the publishing mapper, so they build with the germinal Commodity details page that asks the temperature and with the germinal interim type codes the germinal-products area drafts for the same row. Temperature storage is observable only through the germinal page that asks it, so it is not a row of its own. c-273: live lines gain LIVE_ANIMAL alongside the germinal lines' own codes. Publishing is observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload and on the local stack's outbox, in every environment the row builds in; nothing reaches the real downstream system from a local stack, and no criterion asks it to. The profile, the shared data shape and the gateway mapping are not in this row's repos, which is how the no-change half is kept. Combiner: merge into the row named in existingRow, keeping its id, theme, repos, dependsOn and its open question about the interim germinal codes.

rows.title: Germinal donor, collection and production dates and identification mark are stored unpublished, each date held date-only
rows.detail: The germinal set collects a donor name or ID, a collection date, a production date and an identification mark for each germinal species. The current published profile has no field for any of them, so the animals backend is their only home: it stores them, the service shows them back, and the published payload carries none of them. Each date is held as a date-only YYYY-MM-DD value. Where they sit on the record, on the per-item identifier entries of each line as the record holds animal identifiers, or on the species line, is decided in the build from the real model rather than from the prototype's shape.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal species' donor name or ID, collection date, production date and identification number or mark, once saved, are shown prefilled when the germinal set's Identification details page is reopened. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040, -p1-042, -p1-046, -p1-047; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-046, repo-backend-p1-047)
The collection date and the production date are stored as date-only YYYY-MM-DD values. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-046, -p1-047)

The GBN-AG notification published for a germinal products notification carries only fields the gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 profile defines, so the donor name or ID, the collection date, the production date and the identification mark stay in the animals backend. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040, -p1-042)
rows.notes: The storage half of germinal identification: observable only through the germinal Identification details page that collects the four fields, so it belongs with that page rather than in a row of its own. Where the four fields sit on the record is the build's call from the real model, by the ruling, so no criterion names a field or a class. The date-only rule each date follows is the same one the rest of the record's dates already keep. Publishing is observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload and on the local stack's outbox, in every environment the row builds in. Combiner: merge into the row named in existingRow, keeping its id, theme, repos and dependsOn, and merge these criteria with the germinal-products and animal-identification areas' drafts of the same row.
